set routing-options static route 22.22.2.explanation: Configure a static route with a discard option for a specific IP address and subnet mask

parameters.explanation: The IP address and subnet mask for the static route in CIDR notation

set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.command: set policy-options policy-statement EXPORT-LOOPBACK term 1 then accept

parameters.name: term number
parameters.explanation: The term number within the policy statement

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: The action to be taken (e.g., accept, reject)

parameters.name: unit
